hypothesis: NeuroAI can supply testable mechanisms, but biological analogy should only enter MeshyAnts when converted into a falsifiable software experiment.
falsification_of_watch: An adopted idea has no measurable prediction, treats a podcast as evidence, or is already implied by a simpler scheduler with no leftover test.

adopted.title: Local modules + sparse long-range bridges
adopted.mechanism: BANC: strongest effector drive is local sensorimotor loops; AN/DN circuits form behavior-centric modules; higher regions supervise. Authors analogize to subsumption, not a pheromone swarm.
adopted.software_hypothesis: Workers subscribe to capability neighborhoods. Cross-neighborhood traffic is sparse INSIGHT/DANGER/SATURATION, not global TODO sniffing.
adopted.measurable_prediction: On a heterogeneous failure-prone mix, local+bridge topology reduces coordination messages and duplicate claims vs a flat blackboard at matched quality. On a sequential DAG it does not beat a deterministic orchestrator on quality or wall time.
adopted.falsification: Central router or DAG matches or beats local+bridge on both quality and coordination cost in the heterogeneous regime.
adopted.why_analogy_may_fail: Fly modules are embodied body-part circuits. Software neighborhoods are invented capability labels. A hardcoded subsumption stack may capture the same gain.
adopted.required_baseline: Brooks-style subsumption / inhibit hierarchy, not only a flat queue

adopted.title: Bounded verify/repair recurrence
adopted.mechanism: FlyWire reciprocity 0.138, over-represented vs nulls; ~2/3 of neurons in at least one reciprocal pair; reciprocal edges enriched for E-I pairs.
adopted.software_hypothesis: Topology may include a verifier then repair worker with a retry bound. Software owns the loop; no LLM decides whether to recur.
adopted.measurable_prediction: Bounded verifier-repair lowers undetected-error rate vs one-shot workers at a measured extra cost. Unbounded recurrence raises cost without matching quality gain.
adopted.falsification: A single terminal checker matches error rate at lower cost, or the gain requires unbounded debate.
adopted.why_analogy_may_fail: Synaptic reciprocity is millisecond local feedback, not a multi-agent review cycle.

adopted.title: Integrator/broadcaster as traffic, not Queens
adopted.mechanism: 676 broadcasters and 638 integrators under an arbitrary 5x rule; 37093 rich-club neurons are balanced; rich club is ~30% of neurons; S9: rich club looks like a highway, not a controller.
adopted.software_hypothesis: Integrator combines multi-neighborhood evidence into RESULT/INSIGHT. Broadcaster fans out high-confidence DANGER/INSIGHT. Neither assigns tasks.
adopted.measurable_prediction: A small fixed integrator/broadcaster set reduces missed cross-module constraint failures vs modular-only, while central-assign rate stays at local-claim baseline. Ablation raises missed-constraint failures.
adopted.falsification: A global result log or manager tree matches the missed-constraint metric at equal or lower cost.
adopted.why_analogy_may_fail: Degree imbalance is not a computational role. If integrators assign work, the run is a hidden manager.

adopted.title: Compositional phenotypes
adopted.mechanism: Shared PFC subspaces encode reusable task components and are quieted when unused.
adopted.software_hypothesis: Phenotype = model/tool + policy + versioned skills + permissions + context strategy + budget. Unused skills stay out of context.
adopted.measurable_prediction: On compositionally related tasks, skill reuse has lower cold-start tokens and no worse quality than overlapping role prompts. Unused-skill context inflation increases tokens without quality.
adopted.falsification: Monolithic role prompts match reuse on quality and cost.
adopted.why_analogy_may_fail: Within-brain geometry in two monkeys is not a multi-agent role result. Compositional representations are not compositional workers.

adopted.title: Value-of-learning budget
adopted.mechanism: Humans spend more control when they expect learnability. Extra agents often hurt once a single capable worker exists.
adopted.software_hypothesis: Extra attempts allocated by a deterministic VoL rule. LLM does not decide to try harder. Saturated easy tasks do not get more agents.
adopted.measurable_prediction: After a cold-start capability appears, VoL hits a target success rate in fewer subsequent tasks than greedy, at higher short-run cost and lower long-run regret. On a static easy workload VoL wastes budget.
adopted.falsification: Epsilon-greedy or a central contextual bandit matches the adaptation curve at equal or lower cost.
adopted.why_analogy_may_fail: Human deliberation time is not replica count. S5 is one perceptual task.

adopted.title: Defer selection; multi-objective fitness
adopted.mechanism: Evolutionary MAS can improve some configs but published operators are LLM judges. Strong proxy selection favors luck and Goodharts.
adopted.software_hypothesis: No Queen / phenotype mutation until Phase A-C exist. Future fitness is a vector, never tasks/hour. No LLM evolutionary operator in the core experiment.
adopted.measurable_prediction: Single-proxy selection before Experiment A raises throughput and lowers verified quality vs no-selection.
adopted.falsification: Early single-proxy selection improves verified quality without a hidden quality leak.
adopted.why_analogy_may_fail: Biological fitness is reproductive. Logged software fitness is whatever we choose to game.

adopted.title: Do-not-swarm gate
adopted.mechanism: Equal-budget MAS: extra agents help mainly when the single-agent baseline is weak and work is parallelizable or dynamically explorative. Sequential reasoning is a lose regime. No-verifier topologies amplify errors.
adopted.software_hypothesis: MESH-101 includes a DAG-lose regime, a heterogeneous maybe-win regime, and a recorded single-worker baseline. Strong single-worker baseline predicts MeshyAnts loss.
adopted.measurable_prediction: MeshyAnts loses or ties the DAG regime. Any win is confined to the heterogeneous regime and survives ablation. Unverified volunteer swarms amplify errors more than the central router.
adopted.falsification: MeshyAnts wins universally (treat as baseline handicap) or never wins on the hypothesized regime.
adopted.why_analogy_may_fail: S6 studies LLM conversation topologies, not a software pheromone field. Directional, not a proof about MeshyAnts.
